title: Dynamic Service Recommendation with Congestion-Dependent Joining: Near-Optimal and Constant-Factor Approximation Algorithms
summary: Modern service platforms often provide customers with real-time congestion information, such as anticipated waiting times, before they decide whether to use a service. This creates an intertemporal tradeoff in service recommendation: directing a customer to a service may generate immediate value, but the resulting congestion can make that service less attractive to future customers.
